root = Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-heritage-this-path').read_text().strip())
source = root / 'source'
report = root / 'c3-boundary-probe-controls.json'
assert not report.exists()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('perf', source / 'scripts/whole_project_perf.py')
perf = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(perf)
build = json.loads((root / 'c3-boundary-probe-build-qualified.json').read_text())
assert build['exit_code'] == 0 and build['source_unchanged']
binary = root / 'c3-boundary-probe-tsr'
assert binary.exists()
patch = subprocess.check_output(['rtk', 'proxy', 'git', 'diff', '--binary'], cwd=source)
assert hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest() == build['patch_sha256']
fixtures = json.loads((root / 'c3-rejection-controls.json').read_text())['cases'] + json.loads((root / 'c3-full-index-controls.json').read_text())['cases']
state = {'base_source': '36c9bb5bbb9a642096e697b602b8bbcd2e7267fa', 'probe_patch_sha256': build['patch_sha256'], 'probe_binary_sha256': perf.inputs.file_hash(binary), 'candidate_binary_sha256': perf.inputs.file_hash(root / 'candidate-c3-tsr'), 'cases': [], 'complete': False, 'no_speed_claim': True}
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('TSR_', 'TSGO_')) and k not in ('GOMAXPROCS', 'RAYON_NUM_THREADS')}
env['TSR_LIB_PATH'] = str(source / 'vendor/typescript-go/internal/bundled/libs')
def save():
    report.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2) + '\n')
for fixture in fixtures:
    cwd = root / 'boundary-probe-controls' / fixture['name']
    cwd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    for name, text in fixture['inputs'].items():
        (cwd / name).write_text(text)
    (cwd / 'tsconfig.json').write_text(json.dumps(fixture['config'], indent=2) + '\n')
    case = {k: fixture[k] for k in ('name', 'inputs', 'config')}
    case.update(hashes={p.name: perf.inputs.file_hash(p) for p in cwd.iterdir()}, modes=[])
    state['cases'].append(case)
    for single in (True, False):
        flags = ['--project', str(cwd / 'tsconfig.json'), '--noEmit', '--incremental', 'false', '--composite', 'false', '--pretty', 'false', '--listFiles'] + (['--singleThreaded', 'true'] if single else [])
        mode = {'single_threaded': single, 'runs': []}
        case['modes'].append(mode)
        for role, executable, traced in [('candidate-c3', root / 'candidate-c3-tsr', False), ('probe-off', binary, False), ('probe-on', binary, True)]:
            before = perf.inputs.snapshot([str(cwd), str(executable)])
            child_env = env | ({'TSR_C3_BOUNDARY_TRACE': '1'} if traced else {})
            saved = dict(os.environ)
            os.environ.clear()
            os.environ.update(child_env)
            try:
                row = perf.process([str(executable), *flags], cwd, 30)
            finally:
                os.environ.clear()
                os.environ.update(saved)
            assert before == perf.inputs.snapshot([str(cwd), str(executable)])
            row.update(role=role, trace_enabled=traced, diagnostics=perf.diagnostics(row['stdout'], cwd), loaded=[perf.file_identity(line, cwd) for line in row['stdout'].splitlines() if line.startswith(('/', 'bundled:///'))])
            mode['runs'].append(row)
            save()
            assert not row['timed_out'] and row['exit_code'] in (0, 1, 2)
        mode['diagnostics_equal'] = len({json.dumps(row['diagnostics']) for row in mode['runs']}) == 1
        mode['loaded_equal'] = len({json.dumps(row['loaded']) for row in mode['runs']}) == 1
        assert mode['diagnostics_equal'] and mode['loaded_equal']
        save()
    print(json.dumps({'case': fixture['name'], 'exit': case['modes'][0]['runs'][0]['exit_code'], 'probe_preserves_output': True}), flush=True)
state['source_unchanged'] = patch == subprocess.check_output(['rtk', 'proxy', 'git', 'diff', '--binary'], cwd=source)
assert state['source_unchanged']
pids = [row['pid'] for case in state['cases'] for mode in case['modes'] for row in mode['runs']]
assert len(pids) == len(set(pids)) == 30
state['complete'] = True
save()

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,time
r=Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-heritage-this-path').read_text().strip());s=r/'source';label=sys.argv[1];command=sys.argv[2:];assert command and not (r/(label+'.json')).exists()
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('TSR_','CARGO_PROFILE_')) and k not in ('RUSTFLAGS','RAYON_NUM_THREADS','GOMAXPROCS')};env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR']=str(r/'target');env['RAYON_NUM_THREADS']='8'
def patch(): return subprocess.check_output(['rtk','proxy','git','diff','--binary'],cwd=s)
before=patch();start=time.monotonic()
(r/(label+'.patch')).write_bytes(before)
with (r/(label+'.stdout')).open('wb') as out,(r/(label+'.stderr')).open('wb') as err:
 child=subprocess.Popen(['rtk','proxy']+command,cwd=s,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=err)
 live={'label':label,'pid':child.pid,'command':command,'status':'running','patch_sha256':hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()};(r/(label+'-live.json')).write_text(json.dumps(live,indent=2)+'\n');print('START',label,child.pid,flush=True)
 code=child.wait()
result=live|{'status':'complete' if code==0 else 'failed','exit_code':code,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'source_unchanged':before==patch()}
(r/(label+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
print((r/(label+'.stdout')).read_text()[-3000:],flush=True)
if code: print((r/(label+'.stderr')).read_text()[-5000:],flush=True)
assert result['source_unchanged'];raise SystemExit(code)
